description: Marketing editorial calendar planning environment. editorial_policy.content: Editorial Policy v4.2 (effective 2026-01-12): (1) No more than one post per theme per 30-day window to ensure variety. (2) Only ideas marked status=Approved AND assigned=NO are eligible for new-month scheduling. (3) Minimum two distinct writers per monthly calendar. (4) Each slot must list a publish date, owning writer, and target word count. (5) Writers are only notified after the manager signs off on the final calendar.
